indicators.name: BTC Damped Harmonic Oscillator
indicators.note: DurdenBTC daily oscillator reproduced from its public CSV. No SDCA score is assigned.
indicators.quoteCurrencyDetails: DurdenBTC chart labels prices in USD; the CSV header itself does not declare a quote-currency column.
indicators.calculation: DurdenBTC published model: OLS fit log10(close) = a + b·log10(days since 2009-01-03); fit residuals to A·exp(−γt/2)·cos(ωd·t + φ), γ=8.5e−5, searching 400 ω values from 0.0033 to 0.0054; oscillator = clip((log10(close)−fair)/max(envelope,σ)×100, −100, +100).
indicators.verificationDetails: Reproduced DurdenBTC's published chart JavaScript from its daily CSV and matched the −100 reading reported in the 2026-02-27 article using CSV observations through 2026-02-26.

indicators.name: Bitcoin RSI
indicators.note: CoinSentry weekly RSI reading. A visible CoinSentry backlink is required. No SDCA score is assigned.
indicators.attribution: Free to use with a visible link to https://coinsentry.app (the embed snippets include it). Values update once a day after the UTC close.
indicators.quoteCurrencyDetails: CoinSentry documents its Bitstamp BTC/USD close series as the underlying price source.
indicators.verificationDetails: The published rsi_weekly field is consumed directly; no daily RSI substitute or local transformation is used.

indicators.name: Bitcoin Pi Cycle Top
indicators.note: DurdenBTC Pi Cycle Top ratio. No SDCA score is assigned.
indicators.quoteCurrencyDetails: DurdenBTC chart labels prices in USD; the CSV header itself does not declare a quote-currency column.
indicators.calculation: 111-day simple moving average of daily closes ÷ (2 × 350-day simple moving average of daily closes).
indicators.verificationDetails: Reproduced DurdenBTC's documented 111DMA ÷ (2×350DMA) formula and matched 0.460 on 2026-10-09 at the source's displayed precision.
